headline: GARE11 Real Estate Fund Sells Nine Properties for 791 Million Reais
summary: Real estate investment fund GARE11 signed a contract to sell nine properties, including five rented to Atacadão, to Riza Renda Imobiliária Master for R$ 791 million.
why: Large portfolio transactions by real estate investment funds (FIIs) alter asset distribution and liquidity profiles for investors.

impacts.name: Carrefour Brasil
impacts.why: Property portfolio sales involving leased spaces impact the underlying real estate holdings of retail operations.
